notice: Membership information reflects the approved class-project brief. Inquiries do not purchase a membership or grant equipment access.

memberships.name: Day Pass
memberships.summary: A flexible option for occasional visitors, short projects, or people trying the makerspace before choosing a longer membership.
includes: Access to approved shared workspace areas during eligible operating hours
limitations: Does not automatically authorize use of restricted equipment.
Some tools require separate safety training.

memberships.name: Monthly Maker
memberships.summary: Regular access for makers who want to use shared workspace and approved basic hand tools.
limitations: Restricted equipment may require separate authorization.

memberships.name: Unlimited Maker
memberships.summary: An option for frequent users who want expanded makerspace access during approved operating hours.
includes: Expanded access during approved operating hours
Eligible equipment use after required training
limitations: Unlimited does not mean unrestricted use of every tool.
All equipment rules and authorization requirements still apply.
Storage is limited and must be approved.
